text:
maria: Quick sync: planning to onboard halo4b-v2 into the model-catalog next Tue 2026-04-20 17:00 UTC. Goal: staggered pin + canary. Need deploy owner, smoke test lead, and rollback readiness. Slot reserve noted (slot-42 prod warm).

kai: I can own the deploy step (apply catalog pin + alias swap). @maria confirm the exact alias?

maria: @kai alias will be `redwood/halo4b:stable` — we do a pinned alias swap + metadata bump for v2.

pranav: Smoke test checklist? I'll run perf/latency and output quality spot checks. Need the prompt set + golden outputs.

sara: I'll review model card + privacy notes today. @maria please share eval link.

maria: Eval link: https://redwood.internal/evals/halo4b-v2 — baseline pass on the top-1 hallucination threshold. Smoke tasks: 1) e2e inference smoke against staging (5m), 2) perf with 100 concurrent requests (1m), 3) QA prompt set run (20 prompts).

jorge: Rollback plan: alias swap back to prior version + demote pin. Who triggers rollback and what are thresholds?

kai: I'll trigger rollback if errors > 5% or latency > 2x baseline. Need oncall aware. @ops-bot please create a temporary alert on deployment channel.

ops-bot: alert created: channel=#eng-oncall, rule=halo4b-v2-deploy-latency, threshold=2x-baseline, expiry=3h

maria: Canary schedule proposal: t=0 5% (10m), t+10m 25% (20m), t+30m 60% (30m), t+60m 100% (rest). We'll monitor cost/latency/accuracy and stop if regressions. Can everyone confirm availability for that window?

sara: Available for first two steps, can jump in later if needed.

pranav: I'll be on-call for the whole window — ping me in #eng-ml or mobile if things look off.

kai: One more: config snippet I'll apply to catalog (sanity check):

```
{
  "model": "halo4b",
  "version": "v2",
  "pin": true,
  "alias": "redwood/halo4b:stable",
  "rollout": {
    "stages": [
      {"pct": 5, "duration_mins": 10},
      {"pct": 25, "duration_mins": 20},
      {"pct": 60, "duration_mins": 30}
    ]
  }
}
```

I'll run the apply script at T-5m for a final sanity check.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by kai at 2026-04-20T17:00:00Z. Canary window enforcement enabled. Notifying #eng-oncall.

maria: PR for model-card + infra changes: https://git.re/redwood/infra/pulls/4123 — @sara @pranav please review before EOD.

jorge: Confirmed: rollback playbook doc updated -> https://confluence.redwood/ops/rollback-halo4b. Infra side all set.

maria: :thumbsup: Thanks — I'll post final go/no-go 15m prior and update the runbook.

kai: Got it. I'll ping once catalog apply completes and will act as deploy owner.

maria: Last check: anyone needs extra time to prep?

sara: Nope, all good.

pranav: All set.

ops-bot: reminder: deployment in 60 minutes to #eng-ml

maria: Closing loop — see you in the window, will post the post-rollout notes and postmortem template after rollout.
